svg.title: Linear Fresnel solar plant — Sólvarmaver með Fresnel-speglum
svg.desc: Separate low flat mirrors direct rays toward an elevated horizontal receiver on two supports.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"power-linear-fresnel-solar","label_en":"Linear Fresnel solar plant","label_is":"Sólvarmaver með Fresnel-speglum","section":"06","category_en":"Power plants and generation","category_is":"Orkuver og orkuframleiðsla","batch":3,"tags":["power","solar-thermal"],"description":"Separate low flat mirrors direct rays toward an elevated horizontal receiver on two supports.","design_note":"Low independent mirror strips beneath a high receiver make the Fresnel arrangement distinct from a curved trough.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
